D.treatment: programs publishing a selection criteria policy

O.outcome_detail: public availability of selection criteria policies

cells.quote: 174 accredited ophthalmology training programs were identified, and 51/174 publish a publicly available selection criteria policy.
cells.note: Observational website search with descriptive statistics; the study reports policy availability rather than a learning outcome.

O.outcome_detail: publication of a publicly available selection criteria policy

cells.quote: Of these programs, 51/174 publish a publicly available selection criteria policy, which identify which aspects of applicant CV are valued by the training program: US (33/126), Canada (15/15), EU/EEA (1/31), UK (1/1), and Australia / New Zealand (1/1).
cells.note: Regional observational comparison; higher Canadian policy-publication proportion does not establish a causal effect.

D.comparison: other programs with publicly available selection policies

cells.quote: Interestingly, only 3/51 programs that have publicly available selection policies, ANZ, the UK and Ireland, provide a CV scoring criteria, identifying the relative weighting of various criteria using point allocations.
cells.note: The contrast concerns transparency of scoring, not learner performance.
